'''TIE Sentinels''' were a variant in the TIE series of starfighters utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They possessed irregular folded wings and at least two turrets: One dual-turret cannon on the back of the vessel and another dual-turret gun at the chin of the fighter. It possessed traits similar to that of the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] and the [[TIE/ag "Aggressor" Starfighter/Legends|TIE Aggressor]]. It was at least planned to be developed by the Empire by the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The TIE Sentinels are given a mention in the ''Star Wars: Galaxies'' expansion, ''An Empire Divided'' in a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] known as ''[[Emperor's Eyes]]'', where looking at the painting will show the subtitle that names the craft. Despite this, however, it is not a usable craft, nor does the starship appear anywhere else in the game.
